description: Source code for the LauncherBackend class in Apache Spark, responsible for managing communication with a launcher server, including connection handling, message processing, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: LauncherBackend
classes.description: Abstract class for communicating with a launcher server, managing connection lifecycle, sending commands, and handling disconnection.

classes.name: LauncherBackend.BackendConnection
classes.description: Inner class extending LauncherConnection to handle message processing and connection closure.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the launcher server if configuration options are set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and joins the client thread if active.

methods.name: setAppId
methods.description: Sends a message to set the application ID on the launcher server.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sends a message to update the application state on the launcher server.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the backend is currently connected.

methods.name: onStopRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for stopping the application gracefully.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when the backend disconnects.

methods.name: fireStopRequest
methods.description: Starts a thread to invoke onStopRequest with error handling.
